description: Standard deviation of deposits for identifying outliers.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop-smurfing | WHERE account.event == "deposit" AND event.amount > 0 AND atm.deposit_type == "cash" | STATS deposit_count = COUNT(), avg_amount = AVG(event.amount), std_dev = STD_DEV(event.amount), min_amount = MIN(event.amount), max_amount = MAX(event.amount), total_deposits = SUM(event.amount) BY account.name | WHERE deposit_count >= 5 | EVAL coefficient_of_variation = std_dev / avg_amount, amount_range = max_amount - min_amount | WHERE coefficient_of_variation < 0.5 OR amount_range < 50 | SORT std_dev ASC, deposit_count DESC
